name.full: Azure Databricks Data Connector for Copilot Cowork

description.short: Ask questions of your governed Azure Databricks data from Copilot Cowork.
description.full: Connects Copilot Cowork to your Azure Databricks workspace through the Databricks-provided managed MCP servers (Genie One and, optionally, Databricks SQL). Every request runs as the signed-in user, so Unity Catalog permissions always apply.

agentConnectors.description: Natural-language analytics over governed Unity Catalog data through the Genie One MCP server.
